main_body: Sci-fi metal panel floor/wall block, 4 columns by 3 rows of 16px tiles: riveted plates, a recessed hatch, split plates and a cyan-lit panel
top_band: none. This is a flat terrain tile set, not a standing object. Each plate has a light bevel on its top and left edges and a darker inset, but there is no top surface plus front face to read.
evidence: The candidate is a terrain autotile-style block (floor or wall panels), so the standing-object 3/4 contract does not apply. It has no side faces and no standing volume. The recessed hatch tiles carry an inner shadow on top and left, and the plate bevels are consistent. Judged as terrain, nothing fails.

style.evidence: The plates use about five steps: a pale rivet highlight, a light slate bevel, mid slate, dark slate and a deep navy gap. The cyan accent light adds another colour. The outlines and gaps are a dark blue-slate tint matching the metal, not neutral black. Texture comes from rivets, a speckled dither in the corners and darker patches in the plate centres. The mid-tone interiors are somewhat calm and a bit repetitive from tile to tile, so density is a little below the rich paving reference but acceptable.
